title: Update the capital router readback test for the PM12 portfolio-book exposure shape
summary: Updated services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_capital_router.py test_allocation_and_management_readbacks_retain_pool_and_risk_lineage to align the portfolio-book exposure readback with the PM12 projection shape served since 8d9e1047da (PR #6352) per the 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08 operator decisions. The test asserts the PM12 exposure shape {data: {id, summary, items}, page_info, meta} with seeded pool identities ('pool-paper', 'pool-paused') and exposure figures, and no longer requires allocation_digest on exposure items (a legacy thin capital-router field unread by execute-plans). Seeded _CapitalStore with runtime bindings so portfolio holdings continue to assert strategy lineage ({'alpha', 'beta'}) under data.items without loosening any assertions. Allocation lineage remains strictly asserted where the capital owner enforces it (allocation_line_digest on evaluate step lines), and 0 production files are modified.

test_classifications.reason: PR #6352 (merge commit 8d9e1047da) replaced the legacy thin capital-router exposure list with the PM12 projection returning only fields the execute-plans frontend reads, per the 2026-10-07 operator decision. On 2026-10-08 the operator decided to update the test expectation rather than restoring allocation_digest to the exposure projection. The test was rewritten to assert the PM12 envelope ({data: {id, summary, items}, page_info, meta}) and seeded pool identities/figures without allocation_digest. Allocation lineage remains enforced on the evaluate step lines (allocation_line_digest), and holdings strategy lineage ({'alpha', 'beta'}) remains fully asserted under data.items.

diff_budget.note: Net production line budget 0 strictly satisfied; 0 production files modified.
